Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"Maggie" <netw...@networkx.net> wrote:
> Where does one get some prints of the art that appears on the cards?
> I am looking for this one piece in particular.
> It appears to be a Setite woman holdint the old Egyptian crook and flail.

Retailers at Gaming conventions (Gen*CON, Dragon*CON, ORIGINS, etc.) tend
to have prints to offer.

You may also try contacting the artist directly. Wizards maintains a
list of artists' e-mail and physical mail addresses, searchable at
the URL below.

http://nafsasp.wizards.com/artists_list/welcome.asp

--
L. Scott Johnson (vte...@wizards.com) VTES Net.Rep for Wizards of the Coast.
